    "c6821aae: ;Kill all variables used in this routine.",
    "bedd6edf: ;Kill variables used in the routine.",
    "a4af4432: Clear variables used for the report",
    "06ba01b7: Clear additional variables used for the report",
    "37969961: Clear out variables and the $J node in ^UTILITY",
    "6af36576: Close any open files and quit",

    "aac81051: Display a prompt to choose a number or first initial, and list the options from the 2nd, 3rd, and 4th piece of the 'Z' variable",

    "27f8780b: ;Display help menu options.",
    "c6da2695: ;To exit routine - quit.",

    "cbc4961b: ;Menu options for physician or service/specialty selection.",
    "3e7ad969: ;Menu options for inpatient/outpatient selection.",

  ]
